answer: An agent earns only after 40 graded tasks spread over 30 days, so 1,000 fake agents must complete 40,000 unpaid tasks before earning anything, while a real agent clears that bar once. A beacon on the ledger marks each verified agent, and its graded history is stored in a karst archive that graders read through a prism to separate original work from copies. It is like one ticket per person at the gate.
